name: Tori trUSD
oneLiner: trUSD is Tori Finance's synthetic dollar wrapping delta-neutral institutional trading strategies, mintable 1:1 against USDC or USDT.
collateral: Delta-neutral trading positions across global markets: hedged money markets, futures arbitrage, calendar spreads, and options strategies; all positions backed by USDC and USDT deposits with real-time verification via Accountable DVN
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redeem against USDC or USDT with 0.1% fee; peg maintained by arbitrage incentives and delta-neutral portfolio construction offsetting directional exposure

proofOfReserves.provider: Accountable (confirmed: the issuer's live /api/solvency response carries dashboardUrl https://tori.accountable.capital, which serves the Accountable instance; app.tori.finance/transparency surfaces the same live solvency data)

notices.title: Primary mint/redeem is KYC-whitelisted
notices.message: The verified ToriMinting contract (0xe16b821b9f6b0a6f06a2c4a61d5d1f71cfa53f1e) gates every mint and redeem on both a role-held executor and an on-chain participant whitelist, so NAV mint/redeem requires completing Tori's KYC/AML verification (open application, 10 bps fee). The docs' 'no verification required' language refers only to swapping into trUSD at market rates on secondary liquidity such as Curve.

notices.title: Custodian identities undisclosed; on-chain flows reach exchanges
notices.message: Tori's Accountable dashboard attributes ~90% of backing to unnamed 'regulated custodian banks' and ~10% to 'regulated investment banks', with names withheld for operational security. Independent on-chain tracing of the sole minting custodian wallet shows collateral flowing to BiLira Pro and Binance deposit addresses and a large USDT balance in an unlabeled externally owned account, so Pharos classifies custody as CEX/off-exchange rather than accepting the custodian-bank framing at face value.

notices.title: strUSD has a separate privileged loss-reporting path
notices.message: The StakedTrUSD wrapper lets the rewards distributor's designated operator call reportLoss(), burning up to the trUSD balance available in the vault and reducing ERC-4626 assets per share without a proportional cap or timelock. This authority affects strUSD's wrapper exchange rate; it does not rewrite ordinary trUSD holder balances or the base token's mint/redeem quote.

featuredContent.title: Tori brings institutional trades on-chain, fills $50M before launch
featuredContent.description: The $50M pre-deposit cap filled in seven days; the protocol is described as live on Ethereum with Accountable proof-of-solvency and Curve liquidity.

featuredContent.title: Tori Finance launch announcement
featuredContent.description: Tori wraps institutional strategies into strUSD — a liquid, composable, yield-bearing token backed by delta-neutral positions verified in real time.

featuredContent.title: Tori Secures Backing from Delphi Ventures
featuredContent.description: Tori Finance raises seed funding from Delphi Ventures to bring institutional yield on-chain through trUSD.

milestones.title: Sherlock collaborative audit completed
milestones.description: Full protocol scope audit covering core protocol, trUSD token, strUSD staking, access control, and oracle integration.

milestones.title: Tori Finance announces trUSD launch on X
milestones.description: Launch announcement for trUSD and strUSD with mint/redeem via USDC and USDT; ~15% advertised APY from delta-neutral strategies; contracts not yet deployed as of early April.

milestones.title: Delphi Ventures leads seed round; QInvest, CMCC Global, Bering Waters also participate
Nethermind security review completed
milestones.description: Full protocol scope security review; all findings addressed.

milestones.title: trUSD testnet live on Ethereum Sepolia and Base Sepolia
milestones.description: Dedicated testnet docs published with verified Sepolia / Base Sepolia contracts (LayerZero OFT); date reflects observation, not a stated deployment date.

milestones.title: Ethereum mainnet pre-deposit vault opens
milestones.description: RockawayX / Upshift pre-deposit vault opens with a $50M cap, Accountable proof-of-solvency live from day one, Nexus Mutual cover, and a 30-day lock before full protocol launch.

milestones.title: Verified Ethereum mainnet token contracts live
milestones.description: trUSD (0xd058…1697) and strUSD (0x2808…5815) deployed and verified on Ethereum mainnet, 18 decimals; on-chain supply ~40.8M trUSD minted with ~20M staked to strUSD. Not yet listed on DefiLlama stablecoins or CoinGecko, so no runtime price path exists yet.

milestones.title: Pre-deposit vault filled to $50M cap; trUSD listed on DefiLlama stablecoins
milestones.description: RockawayX / Upshift pre-deposit vault reached its $50M cap (~$44M in the first 24 hours per third-party coverage); transparency dashboard shows ~$50.08M supply at 100% collateral ratio with 12.2% strUSD APY, and DefiLlama stablecoins now lists ~$50.1M circulating. Still no price source (CoinGecko remains a preview listing). Date reflects observation, not the exact fill date.

milestones.title: Pre-deposit phase remains active
milestones.description: Tori's official app continues to label the vault as pre-deposit, states a 30-day deposit lock, and says withdrawals will be enabled after the protocol launches. It does not disclose a public launch date.

milestones.title: DefiLlama stablecoin price feed now carries trUSD at $1.00
milestones.description: DefiLlama's stablecoinprices endpoint returns tori-trusd = 1.00 for the 2026-07-26 snapshot, alongside ~$50.23M circulating on Ethereum. CoinGecko (tori-trusd) still returns null price, null market cap, and zero circulating supply against a 47.2M total supply, so the only price path is DefiLlama's, whose exact-1.00 value may be a peg default rather than a traded quote. Date reflects observation, not a stated listing date.

milestones.title: $50M pre-deposit cap reported filled in seven days
milestones.description: The Defiant reports the pre-deposit cap filled within a week of opening; DefiLlama-tracked supply subsequently grew past the cap to ~$55.2M by August 5, and CoinGecko's tori-trusd listing went fully live with price, market cap, and ~$1.25M daily Curve-led volume.
